_about: Cost assumptions for farm design and finance (farm_plan.py), in Qatari riyals (QR), 2026. They are rough planning estimates for a small farm in Qatar, not quotes: replace them with your suppliers' prices. Every figure the app shows from this file is labelled as an estimate.

greenhouse_cooled_m2.what: fan-and-pad cooled greenhouse, per m² of growing area

shade_house_m2.what: shade-net house (40 % net on steel frame), per m²

drip_m2.what: drip lines, filters and fittings, per m²

soil_prep_m2.what: bed preparation, compost and sand mix, per m²

tank_m3.what: water tank, per m³ of storage

well.what: drilling and equipping a well (only when there is no water on the land)

shed.what: prefab shed / pump house (about 20 m²) for tools, the master node and packing

solar_kw.what: solar power with battery, per kW (only when there is no mains power)

fence_m.what: fence and windbreak, per metre of boundary

sensor_set.what: Hydro Monitor sensor set (Nano, radio, DHT11, soil, light)

actuator_set.what: Hydro Monitor actuator set (Nano, radio, relays)

master.what: Hydro Monitor master node (ESP32, radio, SD card)

hydroponic_m2.what: NFT/vertical hydroponic troughs, pumps, nutrient dosing, per m²

seed_m2_cycle.what: seeds or seedlings, per m² per crop cycle

fertilizer_m2_year.what: fertilizer and compost top-up, per m² per year

cooling_kwh_m2_year.what: greenhouse cooling energy, kWh per m² per year

m2_per_worker.what: growing area one worker can look after (m²)

packing_share.what: packing and transport, share of sales

maintenance_share.what: maintenance per year, share of set-up cost

nutrients_m2_cycle.what: hydroponic nutrient solution, per m² per crop cycle (replaces soil fertilizer)

water_l_m2_day._what: open-field irrigation in the growing season, litres per m² per day
